reuse.why: Uses the shared getMonthActionCategories selection, getSheetValue on the existing sum-amount sheet cells, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable(...)) registration pattern.

duplication.why: Only the small income/expense sign flip is re-expressed, as the average actions already do inline; no shared sign helper existed to call.

placement.why: The action lives in server/budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short, follows the shape of setZero/set3MonthAvg exactly, and inherits future category-selection rule changes automatically.

disguised_duplication.where: The sign flip `cat.is_income === 1 ? netAmount : -netAmount` mirrors set3MonthAvg's `if (cat.is_income === 0) avg *= -1` but is a one-line pattern the tree has no helper for.
